data.name: AboutBody
data.value: Desktop Frames + creates virtual frames on your desktop, allowing you to group and organize icons in a clean and convenient way.

data.name: AboutCreditsBody
data.value:
Desktop Frames + is an open-source utility for Windows, originally created by HakanKokcu under the name BirdyFences.
Desktop Frames + is maintained by Nikos Georgousis, has been enhanced and optimized for stability and better user experience.

data.name: NoteAutoOrganize
data.value: Note: Auto-Organize continuously monitors your Desktop for new files. When a file matches an enabled rule's conditions, it is automatically and physically moved to your target Portal Frame or Folder. Use this to keep your Desktop permanently clean and automatically route downloads to their proper locations.
